OpenAi._BatchInlineImage: true sends the base image inline as base64 instead of by file_id — an escape hatch for OpenAI's batch file-resolution outage. Tried Aug 2026, did not help; see CLAUDE.md.

Pipeline._ShortPrompts: true also writes {runFolder}/short-prompts/ — a shorter copy of every era prompt for pasting by hand into tools that mangle the long form. Same output as the 'short-prompts' CLI mode.

Publish._Enabled: false = the review loop refuses to start and a finishing run is not queued. 'publish <runFolder> --yes' works regardless: a folder typed by hand is consent. Flip to true once Dropbox + Instagram have been proven on one run.
Publish._Targets: Which platforms 'publish' posts to, in order. youtube and telegram take the file directly; instagram and facebook need Dropbox configured (they pull the video from a URL). telegram here means the CHANNEL post, not the review chat.
Publish._Privacy: YouTube's word: private | unlisted | public. Facebook maps it to DRAFT/PUBLISHED; Telegram and Instagram have no private state and post on call.

Music._: Music is laid under the video at publish time only; the run's timeline.mp4 stays silent. Required=true refuses to publish a family whose library is empty; false publishes silent with a warning.
Music._Families: platform → library family, e.g. { "telegram": "youtube" }. Empty = the rule in code: youtube → youtube, everything else → meta. Different licences per platform, so move a platform only if its library is cleared for it.

Telegram._ReviewChatId: YOUR private chat with the bot — a bare user id. Send the bot any message first, run 'review', and the log prints the id of the chat it ignored. Required for the review loop.
Telegram._ChatId: Optional: a channel to post to as a target (@name or -100… id; the bot must be an admin). Leave empty if telegram is not in Targets.

Dropbox._: RefreshToken + AppKey + AppSecret renews itself and is what a scheduled run needs. AccessToken alone lives four hours.

Instagram._UserId: The Instagram professional account id (numeric), not the username. Needs instagram_content_publish.

Facebook._: A Page token, not a user token — the user token can read the Page but cannot publish as it. Needs pages_manage_posts + publish_video.

YouTube._ClientSecretPath: Relative to src/LifeOverYears. The OAuth desktop-client JSON from Google Cloud; YoutubePublisher's perm.json is the same file and reusing it reuses the consent already granted on this machine.
YouTube._Privacy: Never defaulted in code. private + a schedule is the safe pattern: YouTube flips each video public on its own.
